signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Get a one-time link by email. No password.
signIn.anonymous: You can keep using the app anonymously without signing in.

status.sent: Check your inbox. The link works once and for 15 minutes.
status.error: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
status.invalid: That link has expired or already been used.

onboarding.title: Choose your companion
onboarding.intro: Two voices. Pick one and stay with it. You can change later.

practice.title: Today
practice.subtitle: Four questions. Answer one, several, or all.

endChoice.card: Read a learning card on what came up
endChoice.weflection: Move into a We-Flection on something that surfaced

questions.body: What is felt in the body right now?
questions.dream: What dream came in the night? Or what waking dream — what daydream, image, persistent picture.
questions.edge: Where is the edge right now? What is at the threshold of your identified self — what wants to be lived but isn't quite yet.
questions.flirt: What flirted today? What caught your eye, your ear, your attention without explanation.

carryOver.heading: From last time, this was still open

safety.heading: Something deep is asking for attention
safety.linksHeading: If a person in the room would help
